subject.title: fix(ui): prevent unsafe custodian nudge answers

question: Should the deterministic Chromium/Gateway evidence be accepted for this credential-safety change, or should merge wait for a redacted successful live hosted-wizard interaction?
rationale: The implementation and boundary tests are substantial, but the PR explicitly reports that its real hosted-wizard attempt did not reach a prompt, leaving the most important non-mock path unobserved.

options.title: Require live wizard proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted real hosted-wizard run shows disabled nudges during an awaiting step and a successful ordinary answer.

options.title: Accept boundary evidence
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the engine, gateway, and Chromium mocked-transport evidence as sufficient for this constrained safety fix.

recommendation.title: Require live wizard proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted real hosted-wizard run shows disabled nudges during an awaiting step and a successful ordinary answer.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation contributor can provide or coordinate the missing runtime proof, though feature-history ownership could not be independently established here.
